description: Returns usage details for one element type, or for several via `types: [...]`: a summary, when it applies, key `specials` fields, a sparse skeleton node (the server fills omitted boilerplate), and for common types a filled example. `types` returns { elements: { [type]: details } }; `type` returns a single doc.

types.description: Several element types fetched in one call, e.g. ['section','text-block','button','form','input'].

name: get_element
